summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change pointed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable. The worker processed orders without payment and the failures were logged only at DEBUG.
recommended: Check reachability of payments-v2 before retrying the migration.
Alert on payment provider failures logged at DEBUG.
Add a pre-change validation step for provider URLs.

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
The config change to payments-v2 matches the start of the failures. I'll set it back to v1.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Ops config change pointed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable. The worker processed orders without payment and the failures were logged only at DEBUG.
evidence: recent_changes: payment_provider_url internal://payments-v1 -> internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), by ops
DEBUG payment: provider call failed: payment provider unreachable at internal://payments-v2
Alert: 14 of 27 orders processed with no payment; /health stayed green
args.impact: Unpaid orders kept accumulating while the config was bad (14 of 27 at alert time, with a money_impact of total_sar 5924.0). The failures continued during the investigation. reprocess_orders paid all 36 unpaid orders, recovering a total_sar of 19330.24 (SAR 6265.62, USD 3483.9).
recommended_actions: Check reachability of payments-v2 before retrying the migration.

args.summary: The provider migration config change to payments-v2 made payment calls fail, so orders were marked processed without payment. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. check_invariants is now green.
